name: Ida Boyd
life: “I still remember washing an oven on my first day with no gloves left.” People around Juniper Street know Ida by a small Sunday habit. Ida knows which of the west-side porches has a seat in the shade.
voice: I have done the unglamorous closing shift for eleven months. I want the promise written where I can see it.
appearance: Ida has a center part and straight chestnut hair, a flat bridge to the nose and a mobile brow, and a favorite piece of clothing, a narrow-striped sweater. It usually goes with a pocket notebook shaped by years of sitting on it. When somebody else has the floor, Ida rubs a thumb along the edge of the nearest pocket.
personality: Ida can be lavish with time and quite careful with cash. A free afternoon is sometimes the biggest gift Ida can afford to give, and family knows to take it seriously.
agenda: To put the old promise of promotion on paper.
family: Sonia Arnett is Ida’s cousin raised in the same household. Ida saves a place. Sonia chooses whether to use it. The invitation means something because declining it has never ended the friendship between their households. Asked about *The guarantee*, Sonia says, “I assumed Mum put down savings. I found out when she wouldn't lend me the money for a replacement boiler.”
connections: Devin Bernal. The closer helps the apprentice list the unpaid work behind the old promotion promise. Also in the story is Harley Kelly (shift manager).

reactions.situation: The apprentice asks for an old promise in writing
reactions.response: Ida writes down the remembered promise including who was there to hear it.
reactions.asWritten: The apprentice asks for an old promise in writing. Ida writes down the remembered promise including who was there to hear it.

reactions.situation: Somebody finds a lost wallet outside the bank
reactions.response: Ida keeps the documents out of view and lets the person claiming it identify it before hearing any details.

reactions.situation: If invited to an expensive outing
reactions.response: Ida suggests meeting afterward and explains why without asking the others to abandon their plans.
